eRob110T.source: Manual A3-7/A3-8; STEP output face z=-16, T mounting base toward +Y

eRob70T.source: Manual A3-1/A3-2; STEP output face z=47, T mounting base toward -Y

lumpAssumption: Each complete module follows its housing: J1/J2 downstream, J3-J6 upstream. Internal/output relative motion omitted except diagonal reflected rotor inertia. Supplier moving-side split remains requested.

ratingPolicy.brakedRest: Check unpowered static brake acceptance AND repeated gear loading allowance; no dynamic use of brake
ratingPolicy.motion: Check speed-dependent continuous/acceleration curve, rated-torque RMS proxy with motion duty, repeated peaks and speed-weighted cubic average gearbox load
ratingPolicy.caveat: Repeated peak is not continuous servo holding. RMS torque is a screening proxy, not measured current/temperature qualification. No emergency momentary allowance in normal motion.

vendorAcceleration.basis: Manual section 12 recommends acceleration/deceleration time >=0.3 s; acceleration = requested speed / ramp time
